Doc.Summary: Selects this tool.
Selects a tool. The tool column and toolbar toggles reflect it through PressToShape.App.Workspace.EditorState.ActiveTool.
Selects the tool for a shortcut key. Returns false if the key has no tool.
Whether the view can be moved horizontally at all.
Whether the view can be moved vertically at all.

The pointer shape: a closed hand while the view is being dragged, a resize or rotate cursor over or while dragging a handle, otherwise the eyedropper while a pick is active, otherwise the shape of the active tool. The Zoom tool shows the zoom-out magnifier while Alt is held.
The document the canvas draws.
The shape that is being drawn, in screen space, or null.
Largest value of the horizontal scroll bar: the furthest the view offset may go.
Smallest value of the horizontal scroll bar: minus the furthest the view offset may go.
The horizontal scroll bar's value: the view offset, negated, because the bar's value grows when the view moves right. Setting it moves the view.
The visible width, which sets the size of the horizontal thumb.
Whether the view is being dragged right now.
Horizontal screen position of the artboard's left edge, where the horizontal ruler's zero is. The artboard is centered (also when it is larger than the canvas area) and then moved by the view offset.
Vertical screen position of the artboard's top edge. The vertical ruler's zero is here.
Everything the canvas draws for the selection: outlines, frame, handles and the box being dragged.
Largest value of the vertical scroll bar.
Smallest value of the vertical scroll bar.
The vertical scroll bar's value, see PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.CanvasAreaViewModel.HorizontalScrollValue.
The visible height, which sets the size of the vertical thumb.
Whether the shapes all have no color (no fill or no stroke). Never true while the field is disabled.
The position in the history: 0 is the start state, k is the state after the k-th step.
The translated name of the row.
The step type, or null for the start row.
The rows, oldest first. The first row is the start state.

The row of the current state. Setting another row jumps to its state, which may be refused (while a drag is in progress), and the selection then goes back to the current row. null is ignored: one row is always current.
The selected tab as an index, for binding to a tab strip. Out-of-range values are ignored.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.LayerItemViewModel.ToggleLock.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.LayerItemViewModel.ToggleVisibility.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.LayersViewModel.AddLayer.
The row of the active layer, the layer new shapes go into. Setting it changes the active layer. null is ignored: there is always an active layer, and the list control sends null while it is rebuilt.
Largest accepted value.
Smallest accepted value.
Whether the palette has no swatches, for the hint that replaces the list.
The swatches of the current document, in order.
"Nothing selected", "1 selected" or "N selected".
The opacity from 0 to 100.
The swatches saved with the document.
The colors picked lately, most recent first.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.PropertiesViewModel.ResetTransform.
The rotation in degrees. Disabled for several shapes.
Whether the selection header is shown: any tool that has at least one section.
Whether the active tool has no properties, so a hint replaces the sections.
The translated tool name.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ToolItemViewModel.Select.
The translated name with the shortcut key, such as "Select (V)".
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ToolboxViewModel.ResetColors.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand`1 instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ToolboxViewModel.SelectTool.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ToolboxViewModel.SwapColors.
All tools in display order.
Geometry of the canvas area: where the artboard is drawn and where the ruler zero points are. The view only reports the viewport size, everything else is derived here.

A color of the Properties tab (fill or stroke). While the color picker is open the user's changes are previewed on the canvas (PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ColorFieldViewModel.Update) and the whole edit becomes one undo step when the picker closes (PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.ColorFieldViewModel.EndEdit). "None" and a color chosen elsewhere take effect at once as one step.
One row of the History tab: the start state (PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.HistoryItemViewModel.Type is null) or a step. The name is translated when it is read, so it follows a language switch.

State of the History tab: the start state and one row per step, oldest first. The selected row is the current state, and selecting another row jumps there. The list is rebuilt only when the sequence of steps changed, otherwise the rows are updated in place, so undo and redo do not disturb the list under the user's click.
State of the inspector: the selected tab and the view models of its tabs.

One row of the layer list. Name, visibility and lock are display values copied from the document by PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.LayerItemViewModel.Update. The toggle commands edit the document through the editor state, they never change these values directly.

State of the Layers tab: the layers of the current document, topmost first. The list follows the document. When only names, visibility or locks changed, the existing items are updated, so the list is not rebuilt under the user's click.

A number text box of the Properties tab. The text is typed by the user and applied with PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.NumberFieldViewModel.Commit (Enter or leaving the box). Invalid text is never applied: the previous value comes back. Numbers are shown and parsed with the language's culture; a dot is accepted as the decimal separator in every language.
The swatches saved with the document, shown in the Appearance section. Adding and removing a swatch is one undo step. Applying a swatch sets the fill or the stroke like a color chosen in the picker.
An inspector tab that only shows an empty-state message (Assets). Title and message are message ids.

The Properties tab: the position, size, rotation and appearance of the selected shapes, and the section expansion. The fields show the current values (updated in place while shapes are dragged or edited elsewhere) and every committed edit is one undo step.
One button of the tool column.
State of the tool column: tool list, active tool, shortcut lookup, and the (not yet usable) color swatch commands.
